# Complete public-method reference

[User guide](../USER_GUIDE.md) · [Practical API guide](../API_GUIDE.md) · [Build instructions](../BUILDING.md)

Compiler-derived inventory: **11275 public method entries** from **712 Scala 3 API pages**. Excluded 752 protected/private method entries. Overloads have separate entries.

Scope: every public `def` exposed on the generated `com.cra.figaro` API pages, including abstract methods and compiler-generated methods shown by Scaladoc. Inherited members are included wherever Scaladoc renders them. Fields, type aliases, primary constructor signatures, inheritance diagrams, and members hidden by Scaladoc remain available in the linked full API site; this handbook does not reclassify them as functions.

Each entry gives the compiler signature, type/value/context parameters, return type, available source contract, and an **invocation template**. Templates assume appropriately typed variables/type arguments and an existing receiver; they are not standalone programs or independently executed tests. Some low-level APIs require subclass/inference-engine context. Use the tested complete examples in the user guide to begin.

Missing behavioral prose is explicitly labeled; compiler-derived types do not prove an undocumented precondition or algorithm guarantee. See the practical guide for expanded user-facing contracts.

Generate the linked searchable HTML with `sbt "figaro / Compile / doc"`. Its relative links resolve in a local checkout after generation, not in GitHub's Markdown viewer. This Markdown reference itself is readable on GitHub without a build.
